description: Dept. of Trade & Investment Policy - Notify the Special Commodity Levy on potatoes, B'Onions, with effect from 02.11.2018
categorisation: This gazette notification imposes a Special Commodity Levy on specific goods under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves the exercise of statutory powers to create a regulatory measure (tax/levy) on commodities, which is a regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
